question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who tends to look at the dark side of things
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pessimist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Pessimist"** refers to someone who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen. (निराशावादी)

 
 
• **Example:** As a pessimist, he always expects his plans to fail, even before starting.
 
 
 
• **"Optimist"** is the opposite of a pessimist, referring to someone who looks at the bright side of things. (आशावादी)
 
 
• **Example:** An optimist sees the opportunity in every difficulty.
 
 
 
• Hence, the term "Pessimist" best fits the given group of words.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pessimist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dynamist** (शक्तिवादी): Refers to someone who emphasizes the importance of energy or force, particularly in philosophy.

 
 
• **Example:** A dynamist believes that energy is the key to progress and innovation.
 
 
 
• **Polemist** (विवादक): Refers to someone who engages in controversial debates or disputes.
 
 
• **Example:** The polemist wrote a scathing article criticizing the government’s policies.
 
 
 
• **Optimist** (आशावादी): Refers to someone who always looks at the positive side of things.
 
 
• **Example:** Her optimistic attitude made her a favorite among her colleagues.
